_comment: Audit topics: the rules and skills that cover one job. `install.sh audit --topic <name>` keeps only findings and deep reviews from this set, so an agent auditing one area reads only these files. `shared` entries apply to every platform.

concurrency.description: Data-race safety and async correctness: Swift 6 strict concurrency, Kotlin coroutines and Flow.

architecture.description: Module graph, layering, view models, and the data layer: local SPM package or Gradle modules, MVVM, repositories.

accessibility.description: Screen readers, keyboard and switch access, Dynamic Type and text scaling, contrast, reduce motion.

ui.description: Views and composables, design system, icons, and adaptive layout: SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, tokens, large screens.

localization.description: User-facing strings, plurals, formatters, and right-to-left layout: String Catalogs, strings.xml.

testing.description: Test strategy, determinism, and coverage: Swift Testing and XCUITest, JUnit, Turbine, Compose UI tests.

compliance.description: Per-region store rules and review risk: China mainland, EU DSA, licensing, AI provider names in UI and metadata.

logging.description: Logging levels, privacy, and release behavior: os.Logger and Timber.

docs.description: API documentation and project docs: DocC, KDoc and Dokka, README, CHANGELOG, ADRs.

deployment.description: Beta and release shipping: versioning, signing, TestFlight, Play testing tracks, CI upload, R8.

linting.description: Formatter and linter setup and triage: SwiftLint and swift-format, ktlint, detekt, Android Lint.
